draft._doc: THE DRAFT SCORE — the pages that are the score so far, in the order of the piece (the Switch~ piece RUNNING_LOG §368). The notation app marks them "DRAFT n of N" in its picker and plays them as one: where a page's material ends it goes on to the next. A section that is taken into the score is added here.
